title: From Bond to Equation
objective: A bond and an addition equation say the same thing in two different forms — the first explicit Picture to Symbol bridge in the curriculum.
studentQuestion: Can you write what this bond says as a number sentence?
newIdea: The equation whole = part + part as a symbolic form of the bond.

teaching.see: This bond and this number sentence — do they say the same thing?
teaching.break: Map each part of the bond onto a piece of the equation (whole after equals; each part being added).
teaching.build: Write the equation from the bond, and the bond from a given equation (the reverse direction).
teaching.transform: The same relationship, in picture form (bond) or symbol form (equation).

check.prompt: Build the whole with objects and confirm both the bond and the equation describe it correctly.

examples.transfer: A three-part decomposition (e.g. 6 = 2+2+2) expressed as an equation.

mastery.evidence: Correctly translates between a bond and an equation in both directions, for two different wholes.
